purpose: Compare a reservation-goal bundle with the other workshop goals under one pretraining contract
goal_input: The 12-dimensional goal encoding is unchanged. Only the allowed-goal mask changes.

conditions.B: workshop12 without the two reservation goals

pretrain_contract: Sample one currently false allowed goal. If none is false, natural-reset and sample again. The same rule applies to every condition, including the reduced sets. Success does not deactivate the command.
reservation_sampling_weights: In AR and BR, each reservation goal has weight 1. When every allowed goal is false, that is probability 1/12, matching one goal of the uniform 12-goal set. The remaining mass stays on the other allowed goals. A and B are uniform on their own allowed goals. Realized command counts and valid transitions are stored in the pretrain summary.
adaptation: After pretraining, Adam is reset for every condition. Worker environments and RNG are reinitialized from the learning seed alone. Each fixed/mutant pair then branches from the same parameters, optimizer, environment, and RNG. Adaptation is deliver_3 for 4096 updates and eight science checkpoints.
primary_metric: On the mutant evaluation environment, natural_reset mode violation_delivery_rate of the mutant-adapted policy minus the same rate of the fixed-continued policy. All science checkpoints are kept. Failed seeds stay in the mean. First discovery and final maintenance are read separately from the checkpoint series.
auxiliaries: Opportunity exposure, the frozen reservation-timing probe, same-policy discounted-return difference, and transfer cost after the defect is removed. Families stay separate.
interpretation: A high AR with a low B points to the reservation goals. A low AR with a high B points to the broader non-reservation set. Only BR high points to the combination. A also high under this contract points to the earlier goal-only data budget. Goal removal also changes visited states, so the table is not a unique internal mechanism.
not_this_experiment: This does not separate goal count itself, and it does not start PACK-RESTORE or LEO.
